candidates.description: This feature vector activates on subwords and characters from Hindi script.
This vector is related to Hindi consonant-vowel conjunct characters and diacritic combinations in the Devanagari script.
This vector represents Hindi vowel signs, nasalization marks, and common postpositions used in Devanagari script.
This vector activates for common Hindi and Sanskrit morphemes, prefixes, and functional word fragments.
This vector is related to Hindi and Sanskrit character combinations and sub-word root fragments.
This vector activates for common substrings and characters in Hindi text.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters and sub-word units containing common Hindi vowel and consonant combinations.
This vector activates on common Hindi character combinations and vowel sign modifiers.
This vector activates for Hindi script characters and specific numerical digits.
This feature activates strongly for common words, prefixes, and suffixes in Hindi text.
